field_measure_type: S/L controls display format; not a physical unit
field_metadata_source_provenance: Records the request shape this project sends, not the research capture as it was first written: the census asks GetAthleteBioData with level=4 (crates/midwest-census/src/sources/athleticnet/mod.rs:91, applied at collect/walk.rs:54), while the 2026-09-19 research pass first wrote level=0. The field metadata cited above (the IDEvent/IDEventType joins and the isPR/isSR flags) is level-independent, which is why one entry serves both readings.
accuracy_scope: Publisher best claims and retrieved-sample bests remain distinct; no whole-career completeness assertion
